summary: Iteration 11 - Multi-tenant B2B SaaS release gate. 22/22 backend tests PASS (registration, trial, IDOR GET/PUT/DELETE, briefing-live isolation, person/company detail isolation, dashboard/search/persons-enriched scoping, superadmin platform stats/orgs, role authorization). Frontend UI flows verified end-to-end: pricing toggle, registration with terms, trial banner, /account page, org A/B isolation in UI, and superadmin /piattaforma showing both test orgs. Only issue: <StatusBadge> component does not forward data-testid prop so [data-testid=account-status] is missing on Account page.
